description: One solver type from the archive's A–Z model catalog. A solver type is a deterministic model with equation provenance, never a person and never a black box.

model.description: Machine-readable model identity: MODEL-NAME + equation reference or closed-form formula.

modelName.description: Human-readable model name with equation citation.

params.description: Solver parameters, each with unit, default, range, and extraction patterns.

type_id.description: Permanent solver-type ID, assigned once in catalog order.
